scenarios.name: copy-effect-survives-transform
scenarios.why: Cytoshape makes the Outlaw a copy of Elite Vanguard (2/1 Human, no abilities). Moonmist transforms all Humans, and the copy is a Human, so the Outlaw does flip even though what it copies is not a double-faced card; until end of turn it still plays as Elite Vanguard, 2/1 with no first or double strike. The runner starts the Outlaw already back face up (Terror of Kruin Pass, 3/3 double strike, not a Human), so the flip here goes back to the front: once the copy ends with the turn, the Outlaw is the front face again (2/2 first strike, Human). Without the flip it would stay Terror of Kruin Pass.
